name: Anara
desc: Research assistant that reasons over your own paper library.
desc_zh: 基于你自己的论文库做推理的研究助手。
solves: Lets you interrogate a specific set of papers and get sourced answers, instead of searching for them again each time.
solves_zh: 针对一批指定论文提问并得到带出处的答案，不用每次重新检索。
best_for: Reaching for it when you have a specific reading list to work through.
best_for_zh: 手上有一份要啃完的指定文献清单时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Y Combinator company listing; Anara's own rebrand announcement from Unriddle。来源：https://anara.com
